approximationNotes: Two broadside images do not metrically determine hidden thickness or internal bolt geometry.
Strict CS2 silhouette target 0.90 is not yet met; the current deterministic masks are 0.8084 front and 0.8063 back after the thumbhole bevel and brighter inferred side-wall finish.

Orbit repair loop: receiver/stock/grip extrusion walls use a conservative inferred navy coated-steel material because hidden wall pixels are unavailable; the slightly stronger rear fill now preserves a readable finish gradient. Optic ocular/objective collars are short coaxial cylinders rather than free torus loops. Hidden geometry remains approximate.
Medusa paint is a shell-only curved projection from supplied pixels; it is not used as structural geometry.
The thumbhole is a real extruded stock cut with a projection cutout; hidden thickness and interior hardware remain inferred.
